<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Neat Snake 57</title>
<style>
/* Neat Snake 57 by KhaledMatalkah — https://uiverse.io/KhaledMatalkah/neat-snake-57 */
.button {
  display: inline-block;
  position: relative;
  padding: 13px 20px;
  border: none;
  background: rgba(51, 50, 50, 0.287);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: crosshair;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.button:before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -100%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14) 50%, transparent 100%);
  transition: left 0.3s ease;
}

.button:hover:before {
  left: 100%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Hover Me!</button>

</body>
</html>
